第966章 新世界战争要塞，摩擦与战斗，水潭-《废土藏身处，从下水道开始升级》
而在战争要塞的上空，5条战争炼金巨龙傲游巡视着，外围则是血渊军团全面镇守。
巨大的动静，让亡语森林的黄金族群、超维都明白，这里出现了一条不容小觑的过江龙。
“领袖，阿莫斯之眼武器系统已经就绪，可以准备安装，这是相关数据。”
“效果非常好，根据从塔莱文明宇宙获得的能量武器知识，以及咒法文明宇宙的能量聚合技术，升级后的阿莫斯之眼能量凝聚速度提升了112%，能量强度提升了87%，已经到了足够灭杀超维的程度。”
18座文明宇宙的知识传承，足够让整个文明长阶的水平提升一大截。
“现在已经进入最后的第三次测试阶段，根据前两次测试结果来看，这个炼金能量炉完全符合用永久能量炉的标准，这对我们文明来说绝对是一次能源革命。”
“只怕以后我们的能源将彻底实现自由，唯一的缺点是随着能源炉体积变大，相关难点也会指数级提升，想要制造大型能源炉，还有不短的路要走，只能满足小型机械的实际应用，”
“能源体积越大，对材料和工艺的要求就越高，慢慢研究就行，安全放在第一位。”

Chapter 966 New World War Fortress, Friction and Battle, Water Pool - "Wasteland Hideout, Upgrade from the Sewer"
Chapter 966 New World War Fortress, Friction and Battle, Water Pool - "Wasteland Hideout, Upgrade from the Sewer"
In the sky above the war fortress, five war alchemy dragons were patrolling proudly, and the Blood Abyss Legion was fully guarding the outside.
The huge movement made the golden tribe and super-dimensional people in the Deathrattle Forest understand that a river-crossing dragon appeared here that should not be underestimated.
"Leader, the Eye of Amos weapon system is ready and ready for installation. This is the relevant data."
"The effect is very good. Based on the knowledge of energy weapons obtained from the Talai civilization universe and the energy aggregation technology of the Curse Civilization universe, the upgraded Eye of Amos's energy condensation speed has increased by 112% and its energy intensity has increased by 87%. It has reached a level that is enough to destroy super dimensions."
The knowledge inheritance of the 18 civilized universes is enough to greatly improve the long-term level of the entire civilization.
"It has now entered the final third test stage. According to the results of the first two tests, this alchemical energy furnace fully meets the standards for permanent energy furnaces. This is definitely an energy revolution for our civilization."
"I'm afraid that our energy will be completely free in the future. The only disadvantage is that as the size of the energy furnace becomes larger, the related difficulties will increase exponentially. If we want to build a large energy furnace, there is still a long way to go, and it can only meet the practical application of small machinery,"
"The larger the volume of energy, the higher the requirements for materials and processes. Just study slowly and put safety first."
